features: Inputs: 16 BNC (AHD/analog) + 8 IP; up to 24 IP channels (up to 24 channels mixed analog + IP)
urmet.com lists AHD 4K, TVI 4K, CVI 4K and CVBS camera compatibility
IP recording bandwidth 64-192 Mbps per the user manual (64 Mbps default, about +8 Mbps per disabled analog channel)
Coax-channel analytics (user manual): PID / LCD / PD / sound detection / camera tampering / face detection / face recognition

Intelligent video analysis on IP channels (depending on IP camera model): perimeter intrusion detection (PID), line crossing detection (LCD), stationary object detection (SOD), pedestrian detection (PD), face detection, cross counting (CC), sound detection, camera tampering
16 alarm inputs (user manual; urmet.de lists 8), 1 alarm output; 16 audio inputs, 1 audio output (RCA)
Storage not recorded: urmet.de states 1 SATA HDD max 8 TB, the user manual states max 2 SATA HDDs of 10 TB each
Max output bandwidth not recorded: urmet.de states 96 Mbps, the user manual states 192 Mbps
Power consumption not recorded: urmet.de states 10 W without HDD, the user manual states 20 W
Power supply not recorded: urmet.de states 12 V DC 2 A, the user manual states 12 V / 5 A
Ethernet speed not recorded: urmet.de states 10/100 Mbps, the user manual states 100/1000 Mbps
Operating temperature not recorded: urmet.de states -10 to +55 C, the user manual states 0 to +40 C
Dimensions and weight not recorded: urmet.de lists 300 x 53 x 227 mm, the user manual 380 x 50 x 340 mm, datasheet product data 380 x 340 x 53 mm, 3.46 kg
Named in Urmet S.p.A. NDAA Section 889 statement (main chipset), June 2023
